strNotes: The Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery (hydrates, clay hydrates, carbon and meteoric iron into water, carbon stock and nickel-iron ingots), the X2 Chemical Processor (water electrolysis: oxygen into a native O2 canister or the cabin, hydrogen into the H2 Hydrogen Store) and the H2 store. Requires Phobos Framework 0.41.0 or newer and the normal game/BepInEx prerequisites. Water comes from a Shipbreaker S3 or Agriculture R3 vessel within one tile. Shipbreaker 0.38.0 or newer (optional) enables the carburised steel charge. Not gameplay-validated.
